subject: Private deployment scope confirmation + network snags
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kelly <alex.kelly@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment scope confirmation + network snags

Alex / Jia — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side so we have clear agreement on scope, the open risks we flagged, and next steps. Please reply if I missed/incorrectly framed anything.

What we heard (pain & goals)
- Data residency requirement: all PHI-derived telemetry and user data must remain in your AWS account in us-east-1; no long-term copy stored in Redwood-hosted control plane.
- Air-gapped/segregated expectation: network egress must be strictly limited to approved RedHat bastion via your transit VPC during deployment windows.
- Latency SLO: 95p latency for single-turn inference should be <120ms for the clinical workflows.
- Procurement & timeline: procurement aims to sign by end of Q1 2029; technical POC targeted the week after signature.

Key technical constraints we noted
- Private/VPC mode required — we will run our inference nodes in a customer-managed VPC peered to Redwood’s private ingress.
- Outbound IPs must be whitelistable and consistent for glue services (metrics, health checks).
- Host-level management: you asked for HSM/KMS integration for key encryption and an audit trail for model loading and inference events.

Open risks / unknowns (items we need answers on)
1) Egress policy: will you allow a limited managed egress (metrics/health) to a Redwood endpoint, or do we need to push a read-only collector inside your VPC?
2) Bastion flow: how will channelized deployments work if the bastion is maintenance-window only? Can we schedule noncritical updates during those windows?
3) Network diagram: we requested a topology drawing during the call — we only have a high-level sketch. Need a /32 (or range) list for firewall rules and the transit route table IDs.

Immediate next steps (owners & timings)
- Horizon: share a detailed network diagram and NACL/security group rules by Tue 21 Nov — owner: Alex.
- Redwood (Eng): prepare an on-prem/VPC preflight checklist and a tentative deployment runbook by Fri 24 Nov — owner: Monica.
- Redwood (Sales/Legal): provide a draft of the platform data flow and residency note for procurement — owner: Ben (EOD Mon 20 Nov).
- Schedule: plan a technical deep-dive (network + KMS) the week of Nov 27 — action: Alex to propose two 1-hr slots.

Attachments and evidence
- I attached a current SOC2 snapshot and a tiny network sketch you gave during the call (see attachments).

Thanks again — we’re excited to help Horizon get a hardened private deployment that meets your compliance and latency needs.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Alex Kelly <alex.kelly@horizonhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Jia Chen <jia.chen@horizonhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Nov 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment scope confirmation + network snags

Thanks, Priyom — helpful summary. A few clarifications and answers inline: 

- Egress: our security policy forbids direct outbound connections from the private subnet except via the operations bastion. Metrics are acceptable if pushed to an S3 bucket in our account and we provide a read-only role to Redwood.
- Bastion windows: maintenance windows are nightly 0200–0400 ET; for POC we can open a temporary maintenance window in the week of Nov 27 for the deep-dive.
- IP ranges: attaching a more complete diagram and an initial CIDR list. Please note the analytics subnet is in a separate AWS account (acct-74512) so cross-account peering will be required for some telemetry.

Questions from our side:
1) Can Redwood support KMS via customer-managed keys (CMK) scoped to the account and key usage logs forwarded to Splunk?
2) For the latency SLO, what measurement tooling does Redwood recommend to validate the 95p before we sign?

I attached the network drawing (initial-network-drawing.png) and a short security checklist we use. I’ll follow up with the procurement team on timing.

— Alex
Director, IT Architecture | Horizon Health
alex.kelly@horizonhealth.com | +1 (617) 444-3302

(Attachment stubs: initial-network-drawing.png (stub), horizon-security-checklist.docx (stub))

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Alex Kelly <alex.kelly@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment scope confirmation + network snags

Priyom — quick engineering note after digesting Alex’s diagram: 
- We will propose two deployment modes in the checklist: (A) strict-no-egress where we run a push-only metrics collector inside their VPC that writes to S3 via a customer role, and (B) whitelist-egress where we make outbound calls to a stable Redwood endpoint — client preference will drive which we detail in the SOW.
- KMS: we support CMKs. We’ll need an IAM role on the Horizon side with kms:Decrypt for the CMK alias we are given; we can forward key usage logs as CloudTrail events to their Splunk forwarder.
- Latency measurement: recommend a small probe service (k6-based) in the same VPC that hits the inference endpoint under a synthetic traffic profile; we’ll provide the probe harness as code.

I’m drafting the preflight checklist now — will include concrete firewall ports (TCP 443, ephemeral for KV cache sync) and the list of IP/ranges we need for the cluster control plane.

— Monica
Staff Engineer, Platform Integrations | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

(Internal note: we should confirm whether Horizon allows cross-account peering to acct-74512; if not, we need to propose an S3 staging push for analytics.)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Nov 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment scope confirmation + network snags

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Alex. Confirming next steps and owners with revised dates: 
- Horizon (Alex): share final network topology + CIDR list and confirm cross-account peering posture by Wed 22 Nov.
- Redwood (Monica): deliver preflight checklist + two deployment mode recommendations and a k6 probe repo by Fri 24 Nov.
- Redwood (Ben): send procurement note (data residency language + draft SOW anchor) by Mon 27 Nov.
- Schedule deep-dive: Alex — please propose two 60-minute slots the week of Nov 27; we’ll lock one and invite our infra + security SMEs.

We’ll treat the CMK/KMS integration as a gating tech question but not a blocker to procurement; Monica will outline what access we need in the checklist.

Thanks everyone — I’ll convert this thread into a one-page action tracker and post to the HubSpot deal link.

Best,
Priyom
